description: This file is a test script written in shell that sets up a git repository state, performs various merge and cherry-pick operations, and tests the influence of diff algorithms on merge outcomes. It simulates different scenarios by configuring git diff algorithms and verifies success or failure of commands accordingly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the enclosed commands to succeed, with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the enclosed commands to fail, with a descriptive label.
